author: BmB
body:
Okay so i have been temp banned for excessive infractions. 
I believe this is rather pointless and stupid, this is because there doesn't seem to be a set number for "excessive infractions"  when is too much? I have counted the amount of infractions others have received before getting an infraction for "excessive infractions" and it varies every time. As well as this a large portion of my infractions were dealt by inexperienced Junior mods who gave me warns and kicks for little to no reason. 

Therefore i believe that i was banned unfairly and would greatly appreciate it if i could be unbanned, thank you.
